text: Joe Green is an experienced, independent leader who has spent eight years delivering results for Vista. A lifelong Vista resident, small business owner, husband, father, grandfather, and former Vista City Councilmember, Joe is running for Mayor to keep Vista safe, financially strong, and moving forward.

Joe is proudly endorsed by the Vista Fire Fighters Association, the Deputy Sheriffs Association, and a coalition of labor organizations including LiUNA Local 89. Their support reflects Joe’s commitment to public safety, working families, and bringing people together across party lines around the issues that matter most to our community

On the City Council, Joe helped secure funding for public safety, improve roads and infrastructure, strengthen emergency preparedness, expand parks, and support local businesses while protecting taxpayers. As Mayor, he will continue delivering practical solutions that improve quality of life for Vista families.

Joe Green believes Vista deserves independent leadership, not partisan gridlock. Our city needs safe neighborhoods, reliable infrastructure, a strong local economy, and practical housing solutions that fit our community.
With proven experience, broad community support, and an independent voice, Joe Green will continue delivering responsible leadership and real results for Vista.

text: My name is Kenneth Zuniga and I’m your candidate for Vista Mayor. I’m running as a community leader, small business owner, Vista resident, and San Diego State University alumni.

I’ve dedicated time volunteering in my community as an Eagle Scout and throughout my adulthood. Working with local organizations, homeless services providers and advocating on behalf of neighbors at city council, what I hear is the same everywhere: Rent keeps climbing while paychecks do not, and public safety is a concern. I have the audacity to believe we can change that.

In Vista, I have organized with community groups defending immigrant families, stood with local unions, advocated to improve Vista Unified Schools, opposed surveillance technologies that threaten residents’ privacy, pushed for safer pedestrian crossings, and supported those who are experiencing homelessness and on the brink of homelessness.

As a production photographer and graphic designer, I work with diverse teams, manage complex projects that require creative solutions, and build leadership through real-world experience. I’m ready to bring these skills to Vista to address the cost of living by creating truly affordable housing, lowering utility prices, and using the power of government to lower prices, making it easier to put food on the table. I’ll help our homeless neighbors off the streets and into supportive services, invest in road repair, sidewalks, streetlights, and better connectivity. I’ll support local businesses, which are vital to our city and supply a majority of jobs. I’ll support union labor, and work to increase and protect our green spaces.

I’m proud to be endorsed by many community leaders and elected officials such as Vista Unified School Board Trustees Martha Alvarado and Cipriano Vargas. As your Mayor, I’ll continue building relationships across our neighborhoods and prioritize your voice in the Council Chambers. While holding monthly office hours and town halls in dual language.

I promise to show up for you and to keep public resources working for the public. When the government understands its purpose as serving the very working people that it has left behind time and again, it can make a difference in the most pressing struggles facing our city. It’s not just that the government can help, the government must help, and I’m running to ensure our government will help you.
I’m running for Mayor to build on the progress this city has made and push it forward.
